copyErrorConfirm.title: Copy error details?
copyErrorConfirm.warning: Be mindful of what you share on the internet!
copyErrorConfirm.description: The error details might contain your personal data. Copy them unredacted only if a developer asks you to.

apiError.http: Couldn’t get a response from Grindr
apiError.networkBlocked: Something is blocking your requests to Grindr

appError.connectionFailed: Couldn’t connect to Grindr. Check your internet connection and try again.
appError.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
appError.webPage: The server returned a web page instead of data
appError.titledWebPage: The server returned a web page: “{{title}}”

cloudflare.title: Grindr is blocking your requests
cloudflare.description: Cloudflare protecting the Grindr API is currently blocking your requests because of suspicious activity.
cloudflare.advice: You can also rotate the device parameters using the button below.

network.title: Something is blocking your requests to Grindr
network.description: A VPN, DNS filter, captive portal, or school or work network may be answering instead of Grindr, or a server in front of the Grindr API is turning your requests away.
network.advice: Otherwise, switch to another network or rotate the device parameters using the button below.

requestBlocked.vpnHint: If you use a VPN, try disabling it.
requestBlocked.dontShowAgain: Don’t show again in this session

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: Grindr is limiting requests, so your session wasn’t refreshed. Wait a moment and try again.

refused.title: Grindr refused your session
refused.description: Grindr wouldn’t refresh your session. Try again, and if it keeps happening, copy the error details and report them.

unreachable.title: Can’t connect to Grindr
unreachable.description: Open Grind couldn’t connect to Grindr to refresh your session. Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps happening, copy the error details and report them.

sessionError.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

banReason.drugPromotion: Drug promotion or glorification drug solicitation
banReason.nonIllicitSubstances: Casual mentions of legal or non-illicit substances and symbols

networkBlocked.title: Network blocked
networkBlocked.description: This network was blocked by Grindr. Switch it or turn off your VPN, then sign in again.

securityCheck.title: Security check failed
securityCheck.description: Couldn’t pass Grindr security check. Sign out and try again.

ageRestricted.title: Age restricted
ageRestricted.description: Grindr requires your account to complete an age verification check. Complete it in the official app, then sign in again.

ageVerification.title: Age verification required
ageVerification.description: Grindr requires you to verify your age before continuing. Complete it in the official Grindr app, then sign in again. Open Grind doesn’t bypass age verification.

restricted.title: Account restricted
restricted.description: Your account is currently restricted and can’t be used. Check the official Grindr app for details.

unsupportedVersion.title: Update Open Grind
unsupportedVersion.description: Grindr no longer supports this version of Open Grind.

phoneVerification.title: Phone verification required
phoneVerification.description: Verify your phone number in the official Grindr app, then sign in again.

storageNotice.unavailable: This device can’t keep you signed in. You’ll be signed out when the app closes.
storageNotice.plainFile: No Secret Service keyring found. Your sign-in is kept in a plain file that only your system user account can read.

entitlementBypass.title: Paid feature
entitlementBypass.explanation: Open Grind can attempt to bypass this by momentarily spoofing your geolocation to Honduras. <bypassGuideLink>Learn more</bypassGuideLink>.
entitlementBypass.needsLocation: Set your location before using this bypass

autoLocationToast.message: Your location now updates automatically using GPS. Turn this off in the {{menuIcon}} menu.
